title: Hearthlands Mutual Credit Clearing Pool
description: Draft specification for future resource-based local accounting. This file is a planning artifact only. It is not an active ledger, not a live PMA account system, and not connected to checkout or settlement flows.

member_id.description: Local or imported participant identifier. This schema does not require a live DID system.

current_balance.description: Current account standing. Intended future invariant: total balances sum to zero.
